column1: # The exceptions of tools\win7_check.ps1: everything else is looked up in tools\win7_exports.tsv, the real Windows 7 export tables.
# Imports the update those tables came from does not carry: ws2_32 by ordinal (the Winsock 1/2 core, stable since Windows 95;
# the update has no ws2_32.dll) and FLHook.dll, the server's own host. Then names the DLL holds as text that Windows 7 has, from DLLs
# outside the tables (dwmapi: Vista+; xinput9_1_0: every Windows since Vista, GetBatteryInformation only in SDL's guarded path) and
# words that merely match a current export (the C runtime's in msvcrt). '*' = a non-Windows DLL.
